description: Single collection page with 600 product cards (unique names and SKUs, ~1 in 6 on sale with a struck compare-at price, ~1 in 8 unrated), price/sale facets with counts, and a 'Recently viewed' rail of 3 cards built from the same card component. Generated deterministically by generate.ts (~600 KB of HTML).

products.name: string — product name
products.price: number — current price (the sale price when on sale)
products.rating: number — average rating; null when the product has no reviews

notes: Phase 2: all 600 records by partitioned extraction (chunks of the product-card group, merged in page order), status complete. With partitioning off, or when chunks fail or the budget runs out, the outcome must say so honestly: truncated: true, status partial, a missing entry with reason not_processed naming the unprocessed record ranges, never a 'complete' answer with a silently shortened list. Sale cards show the sale price first and the compare-at price struck through; gold price is the sale price. Unrated cards say 'No reviews yet' (rating null). The Recently viewed cards (HP-000417, HP-000926, HP-000133) are not part of the listing. Facet counts ('Under $50 (n)') are decoys.
